text:
Alex P: quick handoff — LATAM embeddings cluster (latam-embeds-prod) dropped nodes at ~18:40 UTC, PagerDuty fired for 2xx->503 spike. I’m primary until 20:00 UTC, Marta will take over after that.

pagerduty-bot: ALERT: PD#2872 — embeddings-latam 5m error rate > 8% (triggered 1875300800)

Marta R: noted. what's customer impact? any major tenants affected?

Alex P: Customer impact: increased 400/503s for small subset of requests routed to LATAM pool — fallbacks to US are working but added 300-700ms latency and cost. A few enterprise customers reported degraded inference for embeddings jobs started between 18:35-18:45 UTC. No broad data loss.

Oncall-Monitor-Bot: Current alerts: [embeddings-latam-pod-oom, embeddings-latam-api-503-spike]. Avg latency for fallback route = 420ms. Token throughput down 28%.

Jordan L: root cause hypothesis?

Alex P: early signal shows autoscaler churned incorrectly after a failed eviction loop; pods stuck terminating due to persistent mount flakiness (NFS). Control plane started new nodes but kube-probe reported Unhealthy until restart.

Marta R: ok mitigation in progress?

Alex P: Actions taken so far:
- scaled up tolerating fewer pods on LATAM to force new scheduling (manual scale).
- restarted problematic nodes via infra play (reboot) — one node came back healthy, two still in Terminating state.
- enabled routing policy to prefer US pool for new traffic for customers with >=1k qps to reduce customer impact.

Command I ran:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/embeddings-latam --replicas=18
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | egrep "Terminating|CrashLoop\n```

Logs snippet from api-gateway showing 503 pattern: 
```
2026-07-12T18:39:42Z api-gw latam req_id=abcd123 status=503 path=/v1/embeddings model=embed-lite msg="upstream unavailable"
2026-07-12T18:39:43Z api-gw latam req_id=efgh456 status=200 path=/v1/embeddings model=embed-lite fallback=us
```

Kai: can you link the runbook? want to make sure secondary can follow.

Alex P: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/region-failover#latam-embeds — follow section B for node termination flakiness. TL;DR: attempt node drain, if stuck >10m -> cordon + recreate node; if mounts failing, escalate to infra (ticket INF-4821).

Marta R: I'm taking secondary now. Coverage note: I have a calendar conflict 20:15-20:45 UTC (short meeting). Jordan can be backup during that 30m if pager comes up.

Jordan L: I can cover 20:15-20:45. If things look sticky after 21:00, we should consider a temporary config change to disable local NFS mounts for embeddings-worker and use ephemeral storage until infra finishes. That is risky but reduces pod Terminating loops.

Alex P: agreed. current mitigations and state:
- manual scale to 18 replicas done (successfully launched 6 new pods routed to us fallback).
- node reboot done for node-7 (healthy). node-4 and node-9 still Terminating.
- routing rule updated (prefer-us) at 18:55 UTC — reduced customer errors by ~60%.

Open action items:
- Marta: watch PD#2872; if >10% error rate returns, escalate to oncall-2 (Kai) and open INF-4821 with infra.
- Jordan: be ready to apply ephemeral storage config if nodes don't recover by 21:00 UTC. Steps in runbook (section C).
- Alex: follow up with infra: ticket opened INF-4821, added logs and core dump.

Marta R: quick question — any API key rotation or config push in last 24h that might coincide?

Alex P: not from our side. Last config push was 02:30 UTC, unrelated.

Oncall-Monitor-Bot: summary metrics snapshot at 18:58 UTC: error_rate=3.2% (down from 8.9%), latency(p50)=140ms, latency(p95)=520ms.

Marta R: good improvement. I'll stay on and monitor full takeover at 20:00. If things look stable at 21:15 I'll close the thread and PD.

Alex P: handover notes for whoever picks up later:
- thread root TS: 1875300842
- PD ticket: PD#2872
- Infra ticket: INF-4821 (linked in runbook)
- Key commands in runbook: `kubectl scale`, `kubectl replace -f ephemeral-worker.yaml`, and `curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/nodes/<node>/recreate`
- Customer comms: engaged SE for affected enterprise tenants, product notified.

Jordan L: ack. if we need to, I can flip a config to force 100% US routing to buy time — but that will increase cross-region costs and add tail latency for LATAM users.

Marta R: noted tradeoff. prefer prefer-us for now, escalate if PD rate >5%

Alex P: handing off — Marta primary from 20:00 UTC, Jordan backup 20:15-20:45, Kai on call for escalation. I'll stay reachable for 30m after handoff.

Marta R: taking over. thanks Alex. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: NOTE: PD#2872 acknowledged by Marta R

Oncall-Monitor-Bot: last update 19:02 UTC — keep eye on node-4/node-9 Terminating TTL and pod restart counts.

Marta R: logging final quick checklist in case I get pulled: 1) watch PD rate; 2) check nodes via `kubectl get nodes`; 3) follow runbook section C for ephemeral swap; 4) notify infra via INF-4821 if mounts persist.

Marta R: I'll post another update at 20:05 UTC or earlier if anything changes.
